scope: Corollary 6.15 (Births and length readouts in matched blocks) of the manuscript “The critical Liouville quantum sphere and geometric limits of FK maps at q=4” (preprints/The-critical-Liouville-quantum-sphere-and-geometric-limits-of-FK-maps-at-q-equals-4-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9b9236021eab20eb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 107. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The finite local comparison may include positive-loop discoveries, negative cut domains, the positions at which internal children attach to the traversal tree, and inherited target intervals. For a block retained wholly in the agreement region, it also includes its macroscopic length path, elapsed Cauchy clock, and uncharted future tree with the shared internal sources. It does not determine the absolute offset from a possibly exterior path origin. Under a constant local Weyl length scaling, both these lengths and elapsed Cauchy time scale by the same constant.
